label: GDC files API
use: Current GDC RNA-seq (STAR gene counts) and 450k methylation (SeSAMe beta values) file metadata. Source of the patient counts in this catalogue.

label: GDC PanCanAtlas publication page
use: Index of the final harmonized PanCanAtlas data files listed below.

label: Merged sample-quality annotations
use: Aliquot-level Do_not_use and pathology-group (AWG) exclusion flags with reasons. Used for every exclusion in this catalogue.

label: Final harmonized RNA-seq
use: Batch-adjusted gene expression matrix (historical representation; not raw counts).

label: 450k-only DNA methylation
use: Whitelisted 450k beta values (historical representation).

label: Merged 27k+450k DNA methylation
use: Not used: 27k arrays are excluded from this catalogue.

label: TCGA Clinical Data Resource (CDR) outcomes
use: Curated clinical annotations and survival endpoints; recommended first for clinical elements and outcomes.

label: Clinical data with follow-up
use: Patient-level clinical table with follow-up records.

label: ABSOLUTE purity and ploidy
use: Tumour purity and ploidy estimates per sample.

label: ISB-CGC PanCancer Atlas BigQuery tables
use: Third-party mirror of the PanCanAtlas files as BigQuery tables; not used for the counts here.

label: Liu J, et al. An Integrated TCGA Pan-Cancer Clinical Data Resource to Drive High-Quality Survival Outcome Analytics. Cell 2018.
use: Describes the CDR and its recommended clinical endpoints.

label: The Cancer Genome Atlas Research Network. Integrated Genomic Characterization of Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma. Cancer Cell 2017.
use: Curated 150-case TCGA PDAC analysis; TCGA-PAAD as a whole is not a curated PDAC cohort.

label: The Cancer Genome Atlas Research Network. Integrated genomic characterization of oesophageal carcinoma. Nature 2017.
use: Describes the distinct squamous and adenocarcinoma groups within TCGA-ESCA.

label: The Cancer Genome Atlas Network. Comprehensive molecular characterization of human colon and rectal cancer. Nature 2012.
use: Characterised TCGA colon and rectal tumours together; outside the hypermutated group, their patterns of genomic alteration were broadly similar. Basis for the pooled CRC cohort.

label: Cornish AJ, et al. The genomic landscape of 2,023 colorectal cancers. Nature 2024.
use: Whole-genome study outside TCGA describing a spectrum of mutational profiles along the colorectum; a reason to keep anatomical site as an annotation within CRC.

label: The Cancer Genome Atlas Research Network. Integrated genomic and molecular characterization of cervical cancer. Nature 2017.
use: Merged histological diagnosis, HPV status and the endometrial-like group used to define the CSCC cohort and its annotations.

label: The Cancer Genome Atlas Research Network. Integrated genomic characterization of endometrial carcinoma. Nature 2013.
use: Histology, grade and the POLE, MSI and copy-number groups kept as annotations of the pooled UCEC cohort.

label: Fishbein L, et al. Comprehensive Molecular Characterization of Pheochromocytoma and Paraganglioma. Cancer Cell 2017.
use: Tumour location, molecular subtype and adrenal-cortical admixture annotations of the pooled PCPG cohort.

label: Mete O, et al. Overview of the 2022 WHO Classification of Paragangliomas and Pheochromocytomas. Endocrine Pathology 2022.
use: Current classification context: historical benign and malignant codes do not define eligibility.

label: Ceccarelli M, et al. Molecular Profiling Reveals Biologically Discrete Subsets and Pathways of Progression in Diffuse Glioma. Cell 2016.
use: Historical histology and grade, IDH and 1p/19q calls and the molecular groups annotated in the glioma benchmark.

label: Louis DN, et al. The 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System: a summary. Neuro-Oncology 2021.
use: Defines the integrated diagnosis and grade that the glioma benchmark compares with historical labels; integrated diagnoses are not yet adjudicated here.

label: TCGA oesophageal carcinoma study, Supplementary Table 1
use: Row-level histology and anatomical site used to define the ESCC cohort and the adenocarcinoma site strata.

label: TCGA pancreatic study pathology review table, via TCGAbiolinks
use: 150-case clinical and pathology table of the TCGA pancreatic study (Cancer Cell 2017); the ‘Histological type by RHH’ field defines publication-reviewed ductal adenocarcinoma. A publication-linked package copy, not a publisher download.

label: TCGA cervical, endometrial, PCPG and pan-glioma tables, via TCGAbiolinks
use: Publication-linked package copies of the marker-paper tables used for CSCC histology, UCEC histology and molecular groups, PCPG histology, subtypes and admixture, and glioma histology, grade, IDH, 1p/19q and molecular groups. Not a new expert slide review.

label: GDC cases endpoint and pathology reports
use: Primary-disease diagnoses, case annotations and open-access pathology reports; reports confirm seven PDAC patients absent from the publication table, document specimen sites for one PDAC and one cervical adenosquamous patient, and confirm two head and neck paragangliomas.
